name: LOG10
description: LOG10 returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.
tldr: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: The positive real number for which you want the base-10 logarithm.

howItWorks: LOG10 computes log₁₀(number), the power to which 10 must be raised to equal the input. It is equivalent to LOG(number, 10) and to LN(number)/LN(10).

howToSteps.name: Select the cell
howToSteps.text: Click the cell for the result.

limitations: The argument must be strictly positive; zero or negative returns #NUM!.
For other bases use LOG(number, base).

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: LOG10 works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Is LOG10 the same as LOG(...,10)?
faq.answer: Yes. LOG10(number) equals LOG(number, 10); LOG10 is just a convenience function.

faq.question: Why does LOG10(1) = 0?
faq.answer: Any base logarithm of 1 is 0 because the base raised to 0 is 1.

faq.question: How do I get a natural log instead?
faq.answer: Use LN for base e, or LOG(number, base) for an arbitrary base.
